_comment: Hand-set values merged over whatever fetch_usage.py finds, and never overwritten by it. Use it to correct a PyPI project it matched on name alone (pypi: null rejects the match, a string replaces it), or to record a country count the Usage prose does not state (countries: N). Keys are tool names as they appear in database_tools.md; fields are any of stars, forks, cran, cran_downloads, pypi, pypi_downloads, citations, countries.

Atomica._why: checked by hand: PyPI `atomica` is the Burnet Institute toolbox, homepage atomica.tools

Emulsion._why: checked by hand: PyPI `emulsion` is the INRAE framework, source on forgemia.inra.fr

GLEAM / GLEAMviz._why: the paper describes the GLEAM model itself; the title spells the acronym out ("GLobal Epidemic and Mobility") rather than naming it, which the title heuristic cannot see

Nextstrain._why: the augur package is published as nextstrain-augur; PyPI's bare `Augur` is an unrelated placeholder

Optima HIV._why: PyPI `optima` is a PyTorch optimisation framework

Pangolin._why: PyPI `pangolin` is a probabilistic inference library; cov-lineages/pangolin is distributed via conda

PatchSim._why: PyPI `patchsim` is the dsih-artpark package, not NSSAC/PatchSim

PyRoss._why: checked by hand: PyPI `pyross` links to rajeshrinet/pyross

SynthPops._why: checked by hand: PyPI `synthpops` is the IDM package, homepage synthpops.org

Vivarium._why: PyPI `vivarium` links to ihmeuw/vivarium, checked by hand; the Code column points at ihmeuw/vivarium-suite, an index repository, so the star and fork counts are the framework repository's

Thembisa._why: Johnson et al. is the Thembisa model's own output paper and its canonical citation, though the title names neither the model nor software

TreeTime._why: PyPI `TreeTime` is an unrelated to-do list manager

civet._why: PyPI `civet` is a Django asset precompiler

scorpio._why: PyPI `scorpio` is an unrelated abandoned package
